name: ai.knowdrive/knowdrive-mcp
title: KnowDrive
description: Private, multimodal knowledge store for agents: hybrid search with cited, provenance-backed results.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWDRIVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: KnowDrive API key (kd_…). Mint one at https://knowdrive.ai/developer-keys, or let an agent onboard itself (see https://knowdrive.ai/llms.txt).

environmentVariables.name: KNOWDRIVE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: KnowDrive deployment to connect to. Defaults to https://knowdrive.ai.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: set to 'Bearer <your KnowDrive API key>' for headless / API-key use. Interactive MCP clients may instead authenticate via the server's OAuth 2.0 (authorization-code) flow and omit this header.
